test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option which can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. In case Options A, B and C are not found suitable, choose Option D: “No Improvement Required.”

Each of the representatives from the various states __have presented their reports__ on healthcare reforms.
solution:
The correct answer is '**has presented their reports**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The subject of the sentence is "**Each of the representatives**", which is singular.
 
• A singular subject requires a singular verb, so "**has**" is the correct verb form.
 
• The phrase "**their reports**" is correct because it refers to the individual reports presented by each representative.
 
• Options 1, 3, and 4 are incorrect because they either use the wrong verb form or do not align grammatically with the subject.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Each of the representatives from the various states **has presented their reports**__ on healthcare reforms."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "have presented their report"** is incorrect because "have" does not agree with the singular subject.
 
• **Option 3: "were presented their reports"** is incorrect because it uses the passive voice unnecessarily and does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 4: "No improvement required"** is incorrect because the original sentence has a grammatical error with "have" not agreeing with the singular subject.
